archimate:Outcome.name: Integrated, Person-Centered Care
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
The "Integrated, Person-Centered Care" goal is a healthcare delivery objective focused on coordinating medical, behavioral, and social services around the unique needs, values, and preferences of the individual patient.
Its purpose is to dismantle fragmented, disease-focused care models by placing the patient at the center of their own care journey and ensuring all providers collaborate to support their holistic well-being.
Example: A community health clinic achieves this goal by co-designing a treatment plan with a patient that simultaneously addresses their clinical hypertension, nutritional access barriers, and cultural lifestyle preferences through a single, coordinated team effort.
